habitat_notes: Farmyard
Road
1993 survey reocrded this grassland as M24. Check for H6410/M24.

1995 survey describes this area as "Series of fields formed from old peat cutting...this results in the presence of a broad mixture of peatland and grassland types, including acid marshy rush grassland , regenerating bog and poor acid fen."
1995 survey describes this area as "heavily degraded wet heath".
1995 survey notes the presence of Cirsium dissectum in this field. Check for H6410.
1995 survey notes the presence of a large Crepis paludosa flush in this field. Noe presence of new drain and track through flush between 2021-2024. Needs checked for presence of H6410/M26.
1996 survey noted M24 fen meadow throughout these fields. Check for presence of H6410.
1999 survey notes this area as mostly improved with some small areas of semi-improved grassland and remnant calcareous grassland on knolls.
1999 survey recorded M24. Check for presence of H6410.
1999 survey recorded this area as species-poor fen meadow. Check for H6410/M24.
1999 survey records this area as M24 but more recent Condition Assessment data record species-poor rush pasture. Check for presence of M24/H6410.
Ash woodland with occasional Salix caprea. Understorey of hazel, hawthorn and sycamore saplings. Hazel more dominant higher up. Treefall gaps frequent most deadwood small. (W9 & W7)
Blanket bog with areas of heath associated with scarps and towards the edge of the peat mass. Limited areas of M24 associated with flushing on steeper slopes.
Blanket bog with patches of heath associated with isolated scarps and around the lakes.
